column1: # Ranked list of US state business registries for jurisdiction US.
# The US has no single federal company register — companies are registered with
# each STATE's Secretary of State (or equivalent). There are no MCP endpoints for
# these, so every entry is kind=`scrape`: the agent does a best-effort, domain-
# scoped web scrape of that state's registry website. If a state yields nothing
# (the company isn't registered there, the site is down, or the scrape fails),
# the agent gives up on it and continues to the next state — same non-fatal
# philosophy as the federated search providers.
# Ranked by how commonly companies are registered there (Delaware first), then
# alphabetically. The agent walks top to bottom and stops early once a state
